name: Can a load-bearing wall be removed to create an open-concept layout?

mainEntity.name: Can a load-bearing wall be removed to create an open-concept layout?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, load-bearing walls can be removed, but they must be replaced with proper structural support, such as engineered beams or recessed headers supported by posts. Removing a load-bearing wall requires calculating the overhead weight from upper floors or the roof and transferring that load safely down to the foundation. When planning structural changes, a licensed contractor coordinates structural assessments and pulls local building permits. If your goal is a flush, seamless ceiling, the support beam must be recessed directly into the ceiling joists rather than hung below.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, load-bearing walls can be removed, but they require structural replacement beams or recessed headers along with proper permits to carry the overhead load safely.
